verdict.rationale: Community users report that n8n can be extended with new integrations and refer to existing documentation for custom node development, though one says that documentation 'leaves a lot to be desired'. No first-party evidence in the pack describes a custom-node SDK, a scaffolding CLI or a developer platform for private connectors. The documented CLI and public REST API are for hosting and instance management, and code nodes are a different feature. missing for 10: first-party custom node/connector SDK docs, a documented node-development CLI or starter kit, guidance for private/self-hosted connector distribution, independent hands-on corroboration of documentation depth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI

citations.quote: Easily extendable and new integrations can be built easily.
The documentation leaves a lot to be desired. Especially regarding custom node development.
